proposals.before: An Chonghui, privy commissioner and grand commandant, became inspector grand master and Hedong commissioner, advanced to duke of Yi.
proposals.after: On yichou An Chonghui, privy commissioner and grand commandant, became inspector grand master and Hezhong commissioner, advanced to duke of Yi.
proposals.reason: 河中 is Hezhong, not Hedong; the correction preserves the named circuit in the Chinese.

proposals.before: Congke had lost Hedong and lived in Qinghua Lane; when An Chonghui left for Hedong Mingzong summoned him weeping: "As Chonghui wished, you would never meet again!"
proposals.after: Congke had lost Hezhong and lived in Qinghua Lane; when An Chonghui left for Hezhong Mingzong summoned him weeping: "As Chonghui wished, you would never meet again!"
proposals.reason: Both occurrences of 河中 denote Hezhong, not Hedong.

proposals.before: On gengyin of the intercalary month An Chonghui was allowed to retire as grand tutor of the heir apparent.
proposals.after: On gengyin of the intercalary month Hezhong commissioner An Chonghui was allowed to retire as grand tutor of the heir apparent.
proposals.reason: The idiomatic version omits the source office 河中節度使; restoring it with Hezhong avoids the recurrent Hedong confusion.

proposals.before: That day Chonghui's sons Chongxu and others secretly fled to Hedong.
proposals.after: That day Chonghui's sons Chongxu and others secretly fled to Hezhong.
proposals.reason: 河中 is Hezhong, not Hedong.

proposals.before: On renchen Li Congzhang of Shan moved to Hedong.
proposals.after: On renchen Li Congzhang of Shan moved to Hezhong.
proposals.reason: 河中 is Hezhong, not Hedong.

proposals.before: On jihai Murong Hua of Huaihua and Eastern Dan received the surname Li and name Zanhua and was made duke of Longxi county.
proposals.after: On jihai Eastern Dan Muhua, commissioner of Huaihua, received the surname Li and name Zanhua and was made duke of Longxi county.
proposals.reason: 東丹慕華 is the already renamed Eastern Dan Muhua, not a person named Murong Hua.

decisions.after: An Chonghui, privy commissioner and grand commandant, became inspector grand master and Hezhong commissioner, advanced to duke of Yi.
decisions.reason: Focus 充河中節度使 names Hezhong, not Hedong, so that place-name must be corrected; the proposed 'On yichou' is not in this unit (prior 辛丑, next 己酉) and is dropped.
Both 自河中失守 and 出鎮河中 are Hezhong; replacing the two Hedong readings restores the circuit named in the Chinese without other changes.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 從珂自河中失守……安重誨出鎮河中

decisions.reason: The edict identifies him as 河中節度使 before ordering retirement as 太子太師; restoring 'Hezhong commissioner' recovers that office and avoids the Hedong misreading.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 製河中節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令安重誨可太子太師致仕

decisions.reason: 潛歸河中 is a secret return to Hezhong; Hedong is the wrong circuit name for 河中.
移鎮河中 transfers Li Congzhang to Hezhong; Hedong has no support in the focus Chinese.
懷化軍節度使東丹慕華 names Eastern Dan Muhua as Huaihua commissioner; 'Murong Hua' invents a Murong surname the Chinese does not use.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 懷化軍節度使東丹慕華
